spans.name: space
spans.text: a software product is a space: what it does by how it's built.
spans.zhHant: 軟體產品是一個空間：它做什麼 乘上 它怎麼構成。

spans.name: time
spans.text: It moves through Time. The backlog holds stories waiting their turn.
spans.zhHant: 它隨時間前進。待辦清單裡的故事排隊等候。

spans.name: backlog
spans.text: A story is romantic: a wish for a better world.
spans.zhHant: 故事是浪漫的：一個讓世界更美好的願望。

spans.name: focus
spans.text: It's focused on customer value.
spans.zhHant: 它聚焦於客戶價值。

spans.name: fuzzy
spans.text: It's fuzzy. It doesn't care about our boundaries.
spans.zhHant: 它很模糊，不在乎我們的邊界。

spans.name: flight
spans.text: It carries an impact we want in the world
spans.zhHant: 它承載著我們想在世界上造成的影響

spans.name: splat
spans.text: and it makes an impact on the product: SPLAT!
spans.zhHant: 也對產品造成影響：啪！

spans.name: wobble
spans.text: Behavior gets messy. Structure wobbles.
spans.zhHant: 行為變得混亂，結構搖搖晃晃。

spans.name: assimilate
spans.text: Developers assimilate the splash
spans.zhHant: 開發者把這片潑濺消化吸收

spans.name: coherent
spans.text: into a coherent product, changed where it matters.
spans.zhHant: 化為一致的產品，只在該改之處改變。

spans.name: impact
spans.text: A story's goal is an impact, with two values.
spans.zhHant: 故事的目標是造成影響，帶來兩種價值。

spans.name: customer
spans.text: Customer value: people feel the new behavior
spans.zhHant: 客戶價值：人們感受到新的行為

spans.name: new-idea
spans.text: and bring new ideas. The backlog is reordered.
spans.zhHant: 並帶來新點子。待辦清單重新排序。

spans.name: tests
spans.text: Option value, unseen by users: judgment spent on tests
spans.zhHant: 選擇權價值，使用者看不見：判斷已花在測試上

spans.name: domain
spans.text: and on a structure that maps the domain.
spans.zhHant: 也花在映射領域的結構上。

spans.name: history
spans.text: The spent story goes to history. Available, but out of the way.
spans.zhHant: 用完的故事進入歷史。隨時可查，但不礙事。

spans.name: next
spans.text: Ready for the next story.
spans.zhHant: 準備好迎接下一個故事。

spans.name: sun-launch
spans.text: More stories come and go
spans.zhHant: 更多故事來來去去

spans.name: sun-assimilate
spans.text: and the product stays coherent. No scars.
spans.zhHant: 產品始終保持一致。沒有傷疤。

spans.name: idea-launch
spans.text: If a new idea fits the same domain
spans.zhHant: 如果新點子屬於同一個領域

spans.name: idea-wobble
spans.text: so it comes cheap: the option pays off.
spans.zhHant: 所以成本很低：選擇權兌現了。

spans.name: idea-history
spans.text: The product shows what is, not what was.
spans.zhHant: 產品呈現的是現在，而不是過去。

spans.name: story-outline
spans.text: One story touches many features
spans.zhHant: 一個故事會觸及許多功能

spans.name: feature-outline
spans.text: and one feature takes many layers working together.
spans.zhHant: 而一個功能需要多個架構層協作。

spans.name: closing
spans.text: Story after story, value builds up. Not debt.
spans.zhHant: 一個又一個故事，累積的是價值，不是債務。

spans.name: finale
spans.text: Stories should be romantic. Products should not.
spans.zhHant: 故事應該浪漫。產品不應該。
